nodes.body: The updated notes correctly record that this no-initialize `/dev/null` probe exits with code 2, but the manifest's `expected_signal` above still declares that the required probe exits cleanly on stdin EOF. The runtime contract is now self-contradictory, so future validation cannot classify the recorded result consistently; either document exit 2 as the intentional non-regression signal or change the probe to send `initialize`.

The explanatory compaction note is inside the backticked path, so the code span is not the actual archive path and cross-reference tooling cannot resolve it literally. Keep the path in backticks and move the compaction explanation outside; the same malformed form is repeated in the other updated references.

This invariant still says `049-S` will be preserved and the blocker file was not compacted, but the current annotations establish that PR #120 shipped `049-S` and the file was compacted on 2026-09-13. Future readers can therefore treat a resolved shipment as an active topology blocker; replace this invariant with a clearly historical statement and a link to the compaction summary.

This closure report points at the pre-compaction path `docs/memory/2026-09-12/ship-049S-progress-checkpoint.md`, which no longer exists; the checkpoint is now archived under `docs/archive/memory/2026-09-13/2026-09-12-ship-049S-progress-checkpoint.md`. Enumerate all 25 paths and pin the command's end revision (or persist a machine-readable diff table) before calling this output reproducible.

The claim that zero stale citations remain is not true at this HEAD: the closure, compound entries, compound-refresh report, and recovery record still contain pre-compaction `docs/memory/...` paths whose files now exist only under `docs/archive/memory/`. Correct the remaining references or narrow this statement to the files actually checked.

Leaving those stale recommendations makes the review artifact report unresolved work that no longer exists; retain only the separate live-client `mcp-client-smoke` condition as the follow-up.

This frontmatter citation stores the annotation as part of the path string, so consumers that use `citations` as resolvable paths cannot find the cited file. Keep each path as its own exact citation and record the compaction summary separately or in prose.

The code span again contains the prose `(compacted 2026-09-13)`, so it is not an exact filesystem path and the memory's cross-reference cannot be resolved literally. Move the status note outside the backticks, as already done by the surrounding supersession prose.
